almanac.line: Ninety-one today, Jesse, and the first real one of the month. Kolbe's lot is already shaded by four. You said yes to the Millstream thing Saturday — that's still on.
almanac.town_line: Warm and still. Sunset comes ninety seconds earlier than it did a week ago.
